nodes.label: SDK golden signing vector
nodes.rationale: Cross-language conformance fixture — base64(HMAC-SHA256(message = timestamp, key = base64(access_key))) — that every SDK core must reproduce so signing cannot drift between languages.

nodes.label: Required-param validation conformance
nodes.rationale: Validation happens BEFORE signing or sending, and fails fast sending nothing; params are baked into sdk-surface.json from the API spec so the check derives from the same source of truth.

nodes.label: Lenient type-validation conformance
nodes.rationale: Coercion-aware because the wire sends everything as strings; type-only with no format/range/enum semantics, and the regexes are intentionally narrow (no +, whitespace, trailing dot or scientific notation) and MUST be identical in JS and PHP.
